column1: # Hand-curated description → Unicode entries not present in the upstream
# 外字注記辞書 (gaiji-chuki dictionary). Two categories are included:
# typographic placeholders where the literal text in `※［＃…］` *is* the
# resolved character (〓, 〻), and spelling-variant aliases of upstream
# entries whose exact wording appears in the corpus but is omitted from
# the dictionary (二重かっこ開く/閉じ → the same glyphs as 始め/終わり二重括弧).
# While the upstream dictionary covers the JIS X 0213 gaiji catalogue, entries
# here supply typographic placeholders and spelling variants omitted upstream.
# Format: description<TAB>codepoint_hex
# (Matching the format of aozora-gaiji-chuki.tsv for unified compilation
# into a single phf::Map.)
# 「〓」(U+3013, GETA MARK) — the standard Japanese typographic
# fallback for "this character cannot be typeset right now". When
# the description literally is the geta mark itself, resolve to it.
# 「〻」(U+303B, VERTICAL IDEOGRAPHIC ITERATION MARK) — sometimes
# appears as a literal description in source.
〻
# 「二重かっこ」 — in the corpus, double white parentheses appear as
# `※［＃二重かっこ開く］` / `※［＃二重かっこ閉じ］` (hiragana, 開く/閉じ).
# In the upstream 外字注記辞書, only the kanji form 始め/終わり二重括弧 is
# listed (U+FF5F / U+FF60, FULLWIDTH LEFT/RIGHT WHITE PARENTHESIS); these
# aliases resolve to the same canonical glyphs.
二重かっこ開く
二重かっこ閉じ
